scope: Independent read-only review of seven frozen editable-grid example files; source approval distinct from final native-dependent qualification.
assessment: Immutable sparse cell candidates use bounded copy-on-write maps with detached admitted strings and increasing cell/source versions. Prior sources remain immutable.
Commit validates after originating settlement, prepares and admits an exact immutable candidate, and installs the domain pointer only after CompleteEdit succeeds.

Pending Save uses an operation token and session identity; cancel, refusal, context completion and replacement operation cannot replay an older acknowledgment. Earlier admitted draft revisions are captured only after settlement.
Return commit event is checked against current exact state. Validation/conflict/unavailable failures preserve draft/source for correction or cancellation.

Smoke errors are retained and joined with native runtime/worker return; emitted stages do not override an error. Readme explicitly separates owner-command Cocoa smoke from actual offscreen routed typing.
qualification_status: Final producer native-dependent proof pending. v1/v2 are historical; v2 all checks return zero but source drift correctly results in FAIL. No new tests run during this review.
limits: No GUI, physical typing, human IME, external AX or performance qualification.
No full prepared/dependency build source closure.
Example values are in memory; file persistence, cell undo and bulk editing remain outside scope.
